impacts.description: Improved employability and career prospects of researchers within academia and beyond, contributing to a stronger and more mobile European research workforce.
impacts.source_section: Expected Outcomes - For supported postdoctoral fellows
impacts.inference_note: The outcome text states 'improved employability and career prospects of MSCA postdoctoral fellows within academia and beyond'; the broader societal impact of a skilled and mobile research workforce is the logical and directly stated consequence of this outcome.

impacts.description: Strengthened international, inter-sectoral and interdisciplinary research collaboration and innovation culture across participating institutions and countries.
impacts.source_section: Expected Outcomes - For supported postdoctoral fellows
impacts.inference_note: The outcome 'new mind-sets and approaches to R&I work forged through international, inter-sectoral and interdisciplinary experience' implies a systemic scientific impact on research culture and collaboration at institutional and cross-border levels, as the acquired experience is disseminated through the researcher's subsequent career.

impacts.description: Broadened public engagement with research and innovation, increasing societal awareness and uptake of scientific outputs.
impacts.source_section: Expected Outcomes - For supported postdoctoral fellows

impacts.description: Enhanced convergence of European researcher working conditions with the principles of the European Charter for Researchers, contributing to ERA policy implementation.
impacts.inference_note: The outcome 'increased alignment of working conditions with the principles set out in the European Charter for Researchers' directly implies a policy impact on European Research Area governance, as Charter alignment is a stated ERA policy objective.

impacts.description: Increased R&I capacity, output, and knowledge transfer among European research organisations, strengthening the scientific base of the European Research Area.
impacts.inference_note: The outcome 'stronger R&I capacity and output among participating organisations; better transfer of knowledge' implies a system-level scientific impact on the ERA's overall research capacity through the cumulative effect of fellowship-driven knowledge transfer across many organisations.

impacts.description: Enhanced integration of current research results into higher education and teaching at host organisations, reducing the research-education gap.
impacts.inference_note: The outcome 'regular feedback of research results into teaching and education at participating organisations' implies a broader societal impact through improved quality and currency of higher education, as research findings become embedded in curricula.
